violations.description: Hardcoded Gemini API key committed as default value in config.py
violations.evidence: config.py line 4: GEMINI_API_KEY = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", "[REDACTED]"), a real-looking API key is the fallback default. The .env.example correctly uses a placeholder, but the actual key is in source control.
violations.recommendation: Remove the hardcoded key from config.py immediately. Rotate/revoke the exposed API key in Google AI Studio. Use os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY") with no default, or raise an error if the env var is missing.

violations.description: Dependencies use minimum version (>=) instead of exact pin (==)
violations.evidence: requirements.txt: requests>=2.31.0, beautifulsoup4>=4.12.0, pydantic>=2.5.0, google-generativeai>=0.5.0. No lockfile exists. Minimum version constraints allow incompatible future releases.
violations.recommendation: Pin exact versions (==) in requirements.txt, or use a lockfile tool (pip-tools, Poetry, uv) to generate a reproducible lockfile.

violations.description: 11 compiled .pyc files are tracked in git despite .gitignore covering __pycache__/ and *.pyc
violations.evidence: git log shows .pyc files were added in commit e85bc19 and modified in aad0373. .gitignore contains __pycache__/ and *.pyc but the files were committed before or force-added. Files: __pycache__/*.pyc (6) and tests/__pycache__/*.pyc (5).
violations.recommendation: Remove all .pyc files from git tracking: git rm -r --cached __pycache__ tests/__pycache__, then commit. The .gitignore already covers them.

violations.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists to run tests or any validation
violations.evidence: No .github/workflows directory exists. No Makefile, tox.ini, or other CI configuration found. Tests exist in tests/ but are never executed automatically.
violations.recommendation: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs pytest on push/PR to main. At minimum: python -m pytest tests/ -v.
